description_en: Retrieves the details of an instance
name: ListCallDetailRecords

parameters.help_en: The product code. The default value for this operation is OUTBOUND_BOT
parameters.help_zh: 产品编码，本接口默认值为OUTBOUND_BOT
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the outbound robot. This parameter is used to specify the instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 外呼机器人实例ID，用于指定查询所属实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从1开始，默认1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录条数，单位：条，默认10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 00:00:00 on the day of the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix毫秒时间戳。不传时默认EndTime所在日的零点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix毫秒时间戳。不传时默认当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The list of call session IDs. The value is a JSON string array. You can specify up to 100 session IDs. If this parameter is not empty, the system queries call records by session ID, ignores other call filtering conditions, and does not truncate the results based on PageNumber or PageSize
parameters.help_zh: 通话会话ID列表，以JSON字符串数组传入，最多100个。非空时按会话ID查询，不应用其他通话筛选条件，也不按PageNumber/PageSize截取结果
parameters.name: session_ids

parameters.help_en: The case ID. This parameter is used to filter call records associated with the case
parameters.help_zh: 案例ID，用于筛选该案例关联的通话记录
parameters.name: case_id

parameters.help_en: The script ID. This parameter is used to filter call records that use the script
parameters.help_zh: 话术ID，用于筛选使用该话术的通话记录
parameters.name: script_id

parameters.help_en: The caller number. This parameter is used to filter call records. The example numbers are synthetic data
parameters.help_zh: 主叫号码，用于筛选通话记录；示例号码为合成数据
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: The callee number. This parameter is used to filter call records. The example numbers are synthetic data
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码，用于筛选通话记录；示例号码为合成数据
parameters.name: callee

parameters.help_en: The list of result codes for filtering. The value is a JSON string array. Valid values: Answered, Unanswered, and Forbidden
parameters.help_zh: 结果编码筛选列表，以JSON字符串数组传入；可选值：Answered（已接听）、Unanswered（未接听）、Forbidden（禁止拨打）
parameters.name: disposition_codes

parameters.help_en: The list of result reasons for filtering. The value is a JSON string array. For Answered, valid values are Normal, SilenceTimeout, TurnsLimitExceeded, Exception, and Transferred. For Unanswered, valid values are Busy, NotExist, PowerOff, OutOfService, NotConnected, NoAnswer, Restricted, and NoRecognized. For Forbidden, valid values are IVR and IVA
parameters.help_zh: 结果原因筛选列表，以JSON字符串数组传入。Answered（已接听）：Normal（正常结束）、SilenceTimeout（静音超时）、TurnsLimitExceeded（轮次超限）、Exception（异常）、Transferred（已转接）；Unanswered（未接听）：Busy（忙碌）、NotExist（空号）、PowerOff（关机）、OutOfService（停机）、NotConnected（未接通）、NoAnswer（无应答）、Restricted（限制）、NoRecognized（未识别）；Forbidden（禁止拨打）：IVR（IVR拦截）、IVA（IVA拦截）
parameters.name: disposition_reasons

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of dialogue turns for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 最小对话轮次筛选值，单位：轮
parameters.name: min_talk_turns

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of dialogue turns for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 最大对话轮次筛选值，单位：轮
parameters.name: max_talk_turns

parameters.help_en: The access channel ID. This parameter is used to filter call records of the specified channel
parameters.help_zh: 接入渠道ID，用于筛选指定渠道的通话记录
parameters.name: access_channel_id

parameters.help_en: The access channel type. This parameter is used to filter call records. Valid values: PSTN, TEST, and TRIAL
parameters.help_zh: 接入渠道类型，用于筛选通话记录；可选值：PSTN（公共电话交换网）、TEST（测试渠道）、TRIAL（试用渠道）
parameters.name: access_channel_type

parameters.help_en: The label search conditions. The value is a JSON object where the key is the label query field and the value is a string. The key must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, underscores, and Chinese characters. The value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot be null
parameters.help_zh: 标签搜索条件，以JSON对象传入，键为标签查询字段、值为字符串；键长度1～64且仅支持字母、数字、下划线及汉字，值最长64，不支持null
parameters.name: label_search

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter call records of the draft version. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates the draft version. A value of false indicates the non-draft version
parameters.help_zh: 是否筛选草稿版本的通话记录：true为草稿版本，false为非草稿版本
parameters.name: draft_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include dialogue transcripts in the response. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否在返回结果中包含对话转写记录：true包含，false不包含；默认false
parameters.name: include_transcripts

parameters.help_en: Specifies the task completion status for filtering. Valid values: true and false. A value of true indicates that the task is completed. A value of false indicates that the task is not completed
parameters.help_zh: 任务完成状态筛选条件：true表示已完成，false表示未完成
parameters.name: task_completed

DispositionReason.description_en: The reason for the call result, grouped by result code. For Answered: Normal (ended normally), SilenceTimeout (silence timeout), TurnsLimitExceeded (turn limit exceeded), Exception (exception), and Transferred (transferred). For Unanswered: Busy (busy), NotExist (nonexistent number), PowerOff (powered off), OutOfService (out of service), NotConnected (not connected), NoAnswer (no answer), Restricted (restricted), and NoRecognized (unrecognized). For Forbidden: IVR (IVR interception) and IVA (IVA interception)
DispositionReason.description_zh: 通话结果原因，按结果编码分组。Answered（已接听）：Normal（正常结束）、SilenceTimeout（静音超时）、TurnsLimitExceeded（轮次超限）、Exception（异常）、Transferred（已转接）；Unanswered（未接听）：Busy（忙碌）、NotExist（空号）、PowerOff（关机）、OutOfService（停机）、NotConnected（未接通）、NoAnswer（无应答）、Restricted（限制）、NoRecognized（未识别）；Forbidden（禁止拨打）：IVR（IVR拦截）、IVA（IVA拦截）
DispositionReason.title_en: 通话结果原因，按结果编码分组。Answered（已接听）：Normal（正常结束）、SilenceTimeout（静音超时）、TurnsLimitExceeded（轮次超限）、Exception（异常）、Transferred（已转接）；Unanswered（未接听）：Busy（忙碌）、NotExist（空号）、PowerOff（关机）、OutOfService（停机）、NotConnected（未接通）、NoAnswer（无应答）、Restricted（限制）、NoRecognized（未识别）；Forbidden（禁止拨打）：IVR（IVR拦截）、IVA（IVA拦截）。
DispositionReason.title_zh: 通话结果原因，按结果编码分组。Answered（已接听）：Normal（正常结束）、SilenceTimeout（静音超时）、TurnsLimitExceeded（轮次超限）、Exception（异常）、Transferred（已转接）；Unanswered（未接听）：Busy（忙碌）、NotExist（空号）、PowerOff（关机）、OutOfService（停机）、NotConnected（未接通）、NoAnswer（无应答）、Restricted（限制）、NoRecognized（未识别）；Forbidden（禁止拨打）：IVR（IVR拦截）、IVA（IVA拦截）。
